column1: # Test cases a cross preset is known to fail, kept out of the CI verdict by run-tests.sh. Each line names its entry in cmake/toolchains/README.md, "Known failures" (symptom, where, suspected cause, owner). A line goes when its fix lands; run-tests.sh says when a listed case passes. Columns: preset, test case, entry, one-line reason.
